reference.note: the generating state of the row-exchange case: its axis, fluxes, current and safety factor from record-10.json, its bounding surface traced on the stored 65 by 129 flux map half a percent of the span inside the recorded boundary flux, where the flux-surface record takes its outermost surface, because the contour exactly at that flux joins the divertor legs

estimators.name: imas-efit
estimators.note: imas-efit's reconstruction of the nominal nova-written pulse, read back through IMAS at the version it was written at

estimators.name: nova-inverse-class
estimators.note: the nova inverse class's result on the same rows: its axis, fluxes, current and safety factor from nova-fit-10.json; its bounding surface traced on the stored flux map at the same edge fraction, on the map the fit recovered (its coefficients are 1.0 and its terminal residual 8.2e-16)

estimators.name: perturbed-copy
estimators.note: a deliberately defective copy of the nova inverse-class state: current scaled by 1.06, boundary and axis shifted 0.03 m radially, flux span grown 2% at each end; the safety factor scaled by 1.05 in the column's own value, because a state written from a scalar record carries its safety factor beside the dataset rather than in a profile
